name: Simplified Model with Isotropic Self-Shadowing
definition: A simplification of the self-shadowing model where the shadowing function is isotropic: $A(\omega) = A$ for all $\omega$. This reduces the number of parameters and simplifies implementation while maintaining sufficient accuracy.
summary: This model simplifies the Microflake Model by assuming isotropic self-shadowing, which decouples directional dependence to enable efficient closed-form solutions for spherical integrals.
